MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME

A map of your people.

Explore the family one connection at a time. Each person is a place to begin.

Find a familiar name

Search for a person and select their result. Their profile opens with photographs, videos and family connections.

Move through the family

Drag the map to move around. Scroll, pinch, or use the + and − buttons to zoom. Fit the map to see the whole branch.

Follow a connection

Choose “Find connection” and select two people. Follow the highlighted path to see how their family records connect.

Explore a generation

Use the generation buttons to move between columns of the family. Solid lines link parents and children; dashed lines link partners.

Prefer the keyboard?

Press Tab to move between controls. With the map focused, use ← ↑ ↓ → to move, + and − to zoom. Select a person with Enter. Press Esc to close this guide.

Names, dates and relationships follow the selected original family chart. Generations are counted from the starting person in that chart, so they may differ between the two views. Some details in the records are still to be confirmed by the family.
